product_overview: Gardiyan is an Android app that limits daily usage time for selected applications. It detects when protected apps come to the foreground and shows a lock overlay once the configured time limit is exceeded.
core_goals: Enforce daily time limits for selected apps
Detect foreground app usage through Accessibility Service
Persist and manage daily counters and session state locally
Reset daily usage counters securely on a new day
Display a blocking overlay when limits are exceeded
Operate without requiring any Gemini/API key or external AI dependency

features.name: Guardian Repository Management
features.description: Manages protected daily counters, session creation, and streak logic for the app's local usage enforcement state.
user_flows: GET /repository/session to fetch the active user session -> Receive 200 with UserSessionEntity -> Use session data to continue tracking protected app usage
POST /repository/reset to perform a secure daily counter reset -> Receive 200 success -> Start a new daily tracking session
GET /repository/session with no existing session state -> Receive 200 with UserSessionEntity indicating default or empty session data -> App initializes tracking from stored baseline
POST /repository/reset when repository state is unavailable or invalid -> Receive non-200 error or failure response -> App keeps previous state and does not start a new daily cycle

features.name: Block Overlay Enforcement
features.description: Shows a full-screen window overlay on top of protected applications when the daily limit has been reached.
user_flows: POST /service/overlay/show when the daily limit is exceeded -> Receive 200 success -> Overlay lock screen is displayed over the protected app
POST /service/overlay/show while overlay permission is missing or service cannot render -> Receive error response or failure -> Protected app remains visible and user is not blocked
POST /service/overlay/show after a limit breach has already been detected -> Receive 200 success -> Overlay remains active or is re-shown to enforce blocking
POST /service/overlay/show during normal usage before the time limit is reached -> Service ignores the request or returns failure -> No overlay is shown and app usage continues
